clips.yt_title: Every Myth Is The Same Story #Shorts
clips.ig_caption:
Every myth you've ever loved is the same story.

Greek, Egyptian, Maya, Norse, Japanese, Mesopotamian — twelve cultures, no contact, and the exact same twelve-beat skeleton. Separation. Initiation. Return.

Joseph Campbell called it the monomyth. Christopher Vogler called it hardwired. 30,000 years of cave paintings, scripture, and cinema all running the same code.

Which means the oldest story on Earth isn't finished. It's waiting on its next chapter — yours.

🎯 Which stage of the journey are you in right now — and who's your threshold guardian? Drop it below. 👇
